story.headline: Friars Score 9 in Win Over Rustlers
story.dek: Wally Puckett goes 3-for-5 with a home run and 1 RBI; Vance gets the win
body: ST. ALBANS — The Friars scored 9 runs on 15 hits Saturday and beat the Rustlers, 9-2, at Sanctuary Field. The Rustlers used 4 pitchers.
Wally Puckett went 3-for-5 with a home run and 1 RBI. He stole 1 base. "I felt fine. I always feel fine," he said.
Jesús Vance (five innings, 6 hits, 2 earned runs, 2 strikeouts) got the win. Rico Gallagher took the loss. He allowed 5 runs in two innings.
"We caught the ball. That was most of it," said Friars manager Rico Washington. Rustlers manager Paige said, "We'll be here tomorrow. We'll try again."
Attendance was 10,746. Time of game was 2:41. Ulysses Delahanty was the plate umpire.
